digest.component_or_area: bug close workflow and ticket state reduction
key_entities: close_class enum values: regression, plan_defect, env_integration, flaky, preexisting, not_a_bug, duplicate, escalated, undetermined
propositions: Bug close --reason is currently validated then discarded; it must be replaced with a required bounded --class enum that persists to reduced state.
The --class enum value must be written to status_data['close_class'] and folded into reduced ticket state via a _fold_close_class helper so it surfaces in rebar show output.

Both transition_core guard (txn.py ~line 221-232) and _completion_precheck guard (transition_close.py ~line 121) must validate the enum; omitting --class must exit nonzero with a message naming allowed values.
The close_class field must be added to ticket_state.schema.json as optional and must be set on *->closed state transitions in both fork-winner and normal-update branches of process_status.

Invalid enum values must be rejected with nonzero exit; the escape value undetermined and all MECE vocabulary (regression, plan_defect, env_integration, flaky, preexisting, not_a_bug, duplicate, escalated) must be accepted.
CLI integration test must verify persistence: `rebar transition <bug> in_progress closed --class regression` exits 0 and `rebar show <bug> --output json` contains close_class=regression.
